Nuclei in hull: cleaned ch0 nuclei inside the edge-filter hull, on the bone side of the soft tissue. Nuclei not labelled: those not inside a surviving osteocyte and not in soft tissue, either inside a ch1 region the filters rejected or without ch1 signal (dye did not reach them).

title: Osteocyte segmentation
text:
Measurements







column
definition




volume_um3, surface_area_um2
region volume; area of the marching-cubes mesh (overestimates a smooth surface by a few %)


axis_1/2/3_um
full axes of the solid ellipsoid with the region’s second moments, \(2\sqrt{5\lambda_k}\), longest first


flatness
\(\sqrt{\lambda_3/\lambda_2}\): ~0 for a sheet, ~1 for a sphere or rod


n_nuclei, nucleus_volume_um3
nuclei with most of their volume inside the region; nucleus voxels inside it


n_dendrites
protrusions beyond the cell body (opening by a ball of 2 voxels) reaching ≥ 2 µm


reach_um
farthest distance of a dendrite from the body surface; the robust length measure


path_um
skeleton length of a dendrite beyond the body, branches summed, spurs < 1.5 µm pruned; unreliable for short, thick processes



Per-dendrite values are in each series’ dendrites.csv (column label is the osteocyte), all pipeline parameters in summary.json.

title: Osteocyte segmentation
text:
Adding a series

Export it from segment_pipeline_interactive.ipynb (Export button).
python scripts/import_series.py <folder with the export> "<series name>": copies it to data/<tag>/ and regenerates the pages
quarto render (or quarto preview), then commit data/<tag>/, series/ and _series_index.md
